name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €86/MWh on 18 Nov, above the €70 Alert line; Hormuz LNG route restricted
state: Dutch TTF gas was near €86/MWh early on 18 Nov, 6.4% lower on the week but 31% higher over three months, 17% below its 52-week high of €104 and well above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). Its largest daily fall of the past five sessions was 6.8%. Qatari LNG relies on the Strait of Hormuz, where Iran's Guards said an LNG tanker hit a mine on 13 Nov (Reuters via gCaptain).
for_you: European gas prices feed into household energy bills and industrial costs; UK price-cap changes follow wholesale moves with a delay. This describes conditions only.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF gas futures (TTF=F)
gCaptain (Reuters) — Iran says tanker carrying LNG hit mine, suffered explosion in Hormuz

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
